(c) full-gate.py _run_verb sends the bug-add --description on stdin via _text_on_stdin; _stream_subprocess takes stdin=None; seams in test_full_gate.py updated; case fglf14. (d) test_drive_phase.py argv_prose_violations reads PROSE_FLAGS from audit-task.py (argv_prose_flags, exempting only review_outcome), reads two-call/+= appends, joined --flag=value forms, flags held in names, and no longer spares calls nested in the helper's arguments (mt5-mt8); _verb_with_text refuses whitespace-only text with a sentence and its docstring says what each blank text does (mt9).
